descFull: Play your PC games on your phone, handheld, Android TV, Fire TV, Windows, Linux or Mac. Free and open source, no accounts, no ads: low latency, HDR, any controller, and your Steam, Epic, GOG, Xbox and other games in one console-style library. Works with Rubylight, Sunshine, Apollo, Vibepollo and other Moonlight hosts.
